subject.title: feat(repair): add digest-bound Gitcrawl evidence intake

question: After the missing-member transaction defect is fixed, should repair intake permanently require versioned Gitcrawl evidence, quarantine legacy jobs, and support local, cloud, and strict parity providers under the stacked action-ledger contract?
rationale: Code review can settle transaction correctness, but it cannot authorize the intentional persisted-job compatibility break or the operational commitment to an authenticated, freshness-bound, fail-closed remote query service.

options.title: Approve strict contract
options.body: Accept evidence-required jobs and all three providers after the transaction fix and exact-head migration, rollback, and workflow verification.

options.title: Phase legacy enforcement
options.body: Keep bounded temporary support for pre-evidence jobs until replacements and archive rollback are operationally proven.

options.title: Split remote providers
options.body: Land local digest-bound evidence first and defer cloud and parity authentication and availability ownership.

recommendation.title: Approve strict contract
recommendation.body: Accept evidence-required jobs and all three providers after the transaction fix and exact-head migration, rollback, and workflow verification.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the existing importer history and the proposed evidence, provider, migration, and workflow contract.
